Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle owner shall be able to securely pair their smartphone with the electric two-wheeler to enable digital key functionality.
Verification Criteria (detail): Demonstration: Show successful pairing process with an authorized smartphone and vehicle.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The E-Key 2W system shall support the secure provisioning of a digital key from the mobile application to the vehicle-side controller via the cloud lifecycle service.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify end-to-end key provisioning flow from mobile app initiation to vehicle-side key record creation.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The digital key enrollment process, from mobile app initiation to vehicle confirmation, shall complete within 15 seconds under nominal network conditions.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Measure end-to-end enrollment time over 20 runs; 95th percentile must be < 15s.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The mobile application shall discover an eligible vehicle via proximity protocols (BLE) and initiate the digital-key enrollment sequence.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify eligible vehicle appears in mobile app and enrollment can be initiated.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall require authenticated owner identity (e.g., biometric or PIN) before provisioning a digital key to prevent unauthorized provisioning.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify unauthenticated user cannot provision key by attempting enrollment without prior login.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller shall accept a new digital key only after receiving and validating a successful enrollment authorization token from the cloud service.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify authorized enrollment creates vehicle-side key record only upon valid cloud authorization.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The cloud service shall generate a unique cryptographic seed for each provisioned digital key and store it securely.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify cloud generates unique seed and stores it in secure vault.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The rider shall experience seamless, hands-free unlocking and locking of the vehicle based on their physical proximity.
Verification Criteria (detail): Demonstration: Show vehicle unlocking as phone approaches and locking as phone walks away.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall automatically unlock or lock the vehicle when an authorized smartphone enters or leaves the defined proximity zone.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify proximity-based unlock and lock actions trigger correctly under nominal conditions.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The target end-to-end unlock decision (from phone proximity detection to vehicle actuator signal) shall complete within 1.5 seconds under nominal environmental conditions.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Measure end-to-end unlock latency over 50 runs to ensure 95th percentile is < 1.5s.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall utilize BLE RSSI thresholds of -65 dBm for the unlock zone and -80 dBm for the lock zone, with hysteresis to prevent flapping.
Verification Criteria (detail): Analysis: Review BLE configuration parameters and hysteresis logic in system design.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller shall unlock the mechanism when an authorized smartphone satisfies the configured proximity policy.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Authorized phone approaches vehicle; verify unlock actuation.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller shall automatically lock the vehicle when the authorized smartphone signal strength indicates it has left the configured proximity zone.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Authorized phone leaves zone; verify lock actuation.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller shall immediately reject unlock requests originating from an unrecognized or unpaired digital key identifier.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Unknown phone attempts to unlock vehicle; verify rejection and logging.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The mobile application shall maintain a background service to continuously scan for the paired vehicle's BLE beacon and report RSSI to the system.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify app scans in background and reports RSSI without draining battery > 5% per hour.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall ensure that only authorized riders with valid permissions can start and ride the vehicle.
Verification Criteria (detail): Analysis: Review security architecture and access control matrices.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall permit ride authorization only when the presented digital key is cryptographically valid, active, and not revoked.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify valid key permits ride, and revoked key is rejected.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle ignition enable signal shall be triggered within 500ms of the mobile app sending the 'Ready to Ride' command.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Measure time between app command and ignition relay closure.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The mobile application shall provide a clear UI indicator to the rider showing whether ride authorization is currently active or pending.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify rider can view active ride authorization status in the app.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller shall execute a cryptographic challenge-response handshake with the mobile app before enabling the ignition relay.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify ignition is disabled if crypto handshake fails or times out.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The cloud service shall validate the key's revocation status in real-time before sending the ride authorization token to the vehicle.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify cloud rejects ride request if key is revoked in database.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle owner shall be able to share constrained, temporary digital key access with other riders securely.
Verification Criteria (detail): Demonstration: Show owner creating a shared key with specific restrictions.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The cloud key lifecycle service shall allow an owner to generate and distribute a shared digital key with configurable constraints (e.g., expiry time, permission limits).
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify shared key expires at configured time and respects permission boundaries.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The shared key token generation and delivery to the recipient's mobile app shall complete within 5 seconds via push notification.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Measure time from owner 'Share' action to recipient app notification receipt.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The cloud service shall enforce that a shared key cannot grant permissions (e.g., ride authorization, speed limits) beyond those explicitly assigned by the owner.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Restricted key attempts owner-only operation; verify system rejection.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The mobile application shall display a list of all currently active shared keys and their associated constraints for a specific vehicle.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify owner sees active shared keys list in the app.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The recipient mobile application shall accept the shared key token and store it in the secure enclave of the device.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify shared key is stored securely and cannot be extracted via root access.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle owner shall have the ability to instantly revoke digital key access in case of loss, theft, or unauthorized use.
Verification Criteria (detail): Demonstration: Show owner revoking a key and vehicle rejecting subsequent access attempts.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall support immediate or scheduled revocation of a shared digital key, propagating the revocation status to the vehicle and mobile endpoints.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify owner can revoke shared key and measure online propagation time.

Primary Text (Description detailed): A revocation command received by the vehicle while it has active cloud connectivity shall become effective and prevent further ride authorization within 10 seconds.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Measure online revocation propagation time from cloud command to vehicle enforcement.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The mobile application shall provide an 'Emergency Revoke All' function that immediately invalidates all shared keys associated with the vehicle.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify emergency action invalidates all shared keys simultaneously.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The cloud service shall maintain a centralized revocation list (CRL) and push updates to all connected vehicles every 60 seconds.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify CRL sync frequency and vehicle update mechanism.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall allow owners to customize rider access based on specific time windows or usage restrictions.
Verification Criteria (detail): Analysis: Review UI/UX designs and backend permission schemas.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall support the configuration and enforcement of rider profiles, including restricted ride modes and specific time-window access.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify rider access is denied outside the configured time window.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The mobile application shall allow the owner to restrict a specific rider's access to a configured start and end time window.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify owner can set and save time window restrictions for a shared key.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The cloud policy engine shall evaluate the current time against the rider's time-window policy before authorizing a ride request.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify cloud rejects ride request outside time window.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller shall enforce speed limits if the active digital key is associated with a 'Restricted Ride' profile.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify vehicle limits speed when restricted key is used.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall provide a secure, temporary access mode for valet or service personnel without granting full owner privileges.
Verification Criteria (detail): Demonstration: Show creation and usage of a temporary service key.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall allow the generation of a temporary service key with predefined, limited permissions (e.g., no trunk access, speed limited) and a strict validity period.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify temporary service key works only during its validity period and with restricted permissions.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller shall enforce valet mode restrictions (e.g., disabling trunk release, limiting max speed to 20km/h) when a service key is active.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify trunk release is disabled and speed is limited under valet mode.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The cloud service shall automatically invalidate the service key and notify the owner when the configured validity period expires.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify service key becomes invalid after expiry time.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall maintain a secure, auditable log of all security-relevant events for owner visibility.
Verification Criteria (detail): Inspection: Review security event log schema and access control policies.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall record all failed authorization attempts and security events with a precise timestamp and vehicle identifier, and expose them only to authorized users.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify failed attempts create an event and unauthorized users cannot read security events.

Primary Text (Description detailed): Security event logs shall be retained in the cloud database for a minimum of 90 days and be immutable once written.
Verification Criteria (detail): Inspection: Verify database retention policies and write-once access controls.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller and cloud service shall record failed authorization attempts with a high-resolution timestamp and unique vehicle identifier.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify failed authorization attempts create a logged event in the system.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The mobile application shall provide a 'Security History' UI screen displaying the last 50 security events in chronological order.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify UI displays correct event history fetched from cloud.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The rider shall be able to remotely check the basic status of the vehicle, including lock state and battery level.
Verification Criteria (detail): Demonstration: Show app displaying accurate lock and battery status.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall periodically synchronize and display the vehicle's latest known connection status, lock state, and battery summary to the mobile application.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify app shows latest lock state and available battery value.

Primary Text (Description detailed): Vehicle telemetry data (lock state, battery) shall be refreshed and available in the mobile app within 30 seconds of a change occurring on the vehicle.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Change lock state; measure time until app UI updates.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The mobile application shall display the vehicle's latest known lock state as reported by the cloud service.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify app UI correctly reflects the latest lock state.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller shall package and transmit telemetry data (battery %, lock state, GPS) to the cloud via MQTT every 60 seconds when awake.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify MQTT message frequency and payload structure.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle shall remain operable for a limited, predefined period if cloud connectivity is temporarily lost after a successful authorization.
Verification Criteria (detail): Analysis: Review offline grace period security risk assessment.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall support a limited offline grace period, allowing the vehicle to accept ride authorization without real-time cloud validation, provided the grace window has not expired.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify vehicle permits configured offline grace operation and rejects after expiry.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The maximum allowable offline grace period shall be 72 hours. After 72 hours, the vehicle shall require a successful cloud sync before allowing ride authorization.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Simulate 73 hours offline; verify vehicle rejects ride authorization.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The offline grace mode shall strictly terminate and reject further ride authorizations the moment its configured validity window expires, regardless of vehicle state.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify expired offline grace period is rejected by the vehicle controller.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller shall maintain a local, secure cache of the last successful cloud authorization timestamp and key validity status.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify local cache is updated on successful cloud sync and survives power cycles.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall support Over-The-Air (OTA) updates for the vehicle-side digital key controller firmware to patch security vulnerabilities.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify successful OTA update of vehicle controller without bricking the device.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The OTA update process shall include a rollback mechanism. If the new firmware fails to boot, the controller shall revert to the previous stable version.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Inject boot failure in new firmware; verify automatic rollback to previous version.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall encrypt all data in transit between the mobile app, cloud service, and vehicle controller using TLS 1.3 or higher.
Verification Criteria (detail): Inspection: Review network traffic captures to verify TLS 1.3 usage and cipher suites.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller shall store all digital keys and cryptographic seeds in a Hardware Security Module (HSM) or Secure Element (SE).
Verification Criteria (detail): Inspection: Review hardware architecture and HSM integration documentation.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall support multi-language localization for the mobile application to accommodate global markets.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify app UI correctly displays text in English, Spanish, and German.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The mobile application shall dynamically load language strings from a localized resource bundle based on the device's OS language setting.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Change device language; verify app UI updates without restart.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall provide a RESTful API for third-party fleet management integration to manage digital keys at scale.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify third-party system can provision and revoke keys via API.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The fleet management API shall enforce a rate limit of 100 requests per minute per API key to prevent denial-of-service.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Send 101 requests in 1 minute; verify 429 Too Many Requests response.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The cloud service shall implement OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow for authenticating third-party fleet management API requests.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify API rejects requests without valid OAuth token.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall support geofencing capabilities to restrict vehicle operation to specific geographic zones.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify vehicle is disabled when taken outside the configured geofence.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The geofence boundary violation detection shall trigger a vehicle immobilization command within 5 seconds of the vehicle crossing the boundary.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Drive vehicle across geofence boundary; measure time to immobilization.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller shall evaluate its GPS coordinates against the stored geofence polygon every 5 seconds while in motion.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify GPS polling frequency and polygon evaluation logic.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The system shall support a 'Find My Vehicle' feature, displaying the last known GPS location of the vehicle on a map in the mobile app.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify app displays correct last known GPS coordinates on the map.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The vehicle controller shall transmit its GPS coordinates to the cloud service immediately upon detecting an unauthorized movement alert (e.g., tilt sensor trigger).
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Trigger tilt sensor; verify cloud receives GPS coordinates within 10 seconds.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The mobile application shall render the vehicle's last known location on an interactive map using the Google Maps SDK.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Verify map renders correctly and displays the vehicle pin at the correct coordinates.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The cloud key lifecycle service shall maintain 99.9% uptime to ensure continuous availability of digital key provisioning and revocation services.
Verification Criteria (detail): Analysis: Review cloud architecture SLA and multi-region failover design.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The mobile application shall implement exponential backoff and jitter for all API retry attempts to prevent server overload during network outages.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Simulate network failure; verify app retries with backoff.

Primary Text (Description detailed): The mobile application shall load the primary dashboard and vehicle status within 2 seconds on a standard 4G connection.
Verification Criteria (detail): Test: Measure app load time over throttled 4G network.
